videos.t: DJI Mavic Pro Tests - Flight 2 - 1080P
videos.desc:
Took my Mavic Pro down to Eton playing fields for some test flights.

Filmed at 1080P 24Fps AE. Edited and exported at 30Fps hence some frame jitter. All manual flight mode apart from auto tracking shot at the end using phone and WiFi control. 

Only noticed about 30 mins into flying the Gimbal roll needed calibrating.

Used two batteries and got about 45 mins flight time, some slow tracking shots and a bit of sport mode flying. Very impressed with this drone and the footage quality.
